home.descriptionBefore: What's trending? Compare songs, artists, and albums to guess which one is more popular on

game.artistsDescription: Guess which artist is more popular on Spotify
game.albumsDescription: Guess which album is more popular on Spotify
game.tracksDescription: Guess which track is more popular on Spotify

gameReady.readyDescription: Try to get the highest score by correctly guessing which {mode} is more popular.

roundCounter.title: Round Counter
roundCounter.description: Shows your current round number. Each round presents two new items to compare.

livesDisplay.title: Lives Display
livesDisplay.description: You start with 3 lives. Lose one for each wrong answer, but gain one for every 5 correct answers in a row!

scoreDisplay.title: Score Display
scoreDisplay.description: Your total score. Get 1 point for each correct answer, with bonus points for streaks!

streakCounter.title: Streak Counter
streakCounter.description: Your current streak of correct answers. Every 3 correct answers in a row gives bonus points!

gameCards.title: Game Cards
gameCards.description: Click on the {mode} you think is more popular. Hover to play its preview audio if available!

endGameButton.title: End Game Button
endGameButton.description: Click to end the game and see your final score and streak.

gamePlaying.endGameConfirm: Are you sure you want to end the game? Your current score is {score} points.

gameFinished.shareCopiedDesc: You can paste it anywhere you want.

profile.title: Profile
profile.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account?

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No scores yet. Be the first to play!
leaderboard.loadError: Failed to load leaderboard. Please try again.
